title: M7.P5: Exercise current upgrade readiness in the regression harness
body:
## Qualification reconciliation — 2026-10-11

The shared helper executes actual wait_for_storage and its guest query. Seven ready/delayed/stale/failed/absent/never/empty states verify outcomes and exact poll bounds; three source mutations are rejected. Integrated final proof02 passes1378/0/0 on frozen image20 inputs. Source51ddf40833 is delivered; see [regression and acceptance controls](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-regression-fixtures).

The earlier remaining-work statements below are historical; the acceptance checklist is reconciled to the evidence above. No owner device/cloud action or publication occurred.

Owner requirement: “Let's fix any caps we discover before we generate a new build.” Clarification: “Also, my last message said, "any caps we…" but I meant "any gaps"”.

Parent: #344; M7.P5. Found during corrected replacement20 qualification. Original QA20 results remain unchanged.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes — disposable host/namespace fixtures exercise the QA harness and its current-boot guest protocol. No owner device or cloud action is needed.

## Current behavior and code trace
F1r-a still extracts `AUTOSTARTED=no` from vm-upgrade-rehearsal. #546 replaced this block with `wait_for_storage`, correctly called before seeding and retained hashes. The main harness reports no wait to grade. Its stale assertion must exercise the current behavior, without weakening boot identity or bounded readiness.
Already written: false host regression failure only. The firmware and actual upgrade guard remain unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] The reusable regression invokes the actual wait and guest query, passing ready and delayed current boots and refusing stale boot, failed service, absent answer, never-ready service and empty identity; logs show expected polling bounds.
- [x] Negative mutations removing boot identity or service readiness are rejected; the old stale extraction failure is preserved, and the integrated corrected full suite passes.
- [x] Source, work/friction log and compact proof are delivered; exact-source checks pass.
